experiment_data.hypothesis: Pythia-6.9B 在 C4 上的 K*=2，与其他 ≥7B 模型一致，验证 K*=2 不依赖 Qwen 家族。

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null && cd /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination && export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com && export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 && echo '=== Downloading Pythia-6.9B ===' && python -c 'from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; path=snapshot_download(\"EleutherAI/pythia-6.9b\", cache_dir=\"/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache\"); print(f\"MODEL_PATH={path}\")' && MODEL_PATH=\$(python -c 'from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; print(snapshot_download(\"EleutherAI/pythia-6.9b\", cache_dir=\"/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache\"))') && echo \"=== Running pipeline with model at \$MODEL_PATH ===\" && mkdir -p data/exp_pythia69b_c4 results/exp_pythia69b_c4 && python scripts/run_pipeline.py --model_path \$MODEL_PATH --data_dir data/exp_pythia69b_c4 --results_dir results/exp_pythia69b_c4 --num_samples 5000 --max_depth 5 --batch_size 4 --feat_batch_size 2 --generation_mode continuation --no_sample"
